children: Shares of Maruti Suzuki were trading over 4% lower on September 1 to emerge among top Nifty losers after the automaker reported 10% sequential decline in August sales at 219,220 units.
Maruti Suzuki reported record total sales of 241,421 units in July 2026.

At 12:50 pm on September 1, Maruti Suzuki shares were trading 4% lower at Rs 13,010 apiece to emerge as top Nifty loser. The Nifty Auto index was trading 0.6% lower with Maruti leading the losses followed by Sona Comstar, Bosch.
Domestic passenger vehicle sales, excluding light commercial vehicles and OEM sales, rose to 176,971 units in August 2026 from 131,278 units a year earlier.

Utility vehicles were the biggest contributor, with sales of 79,045 units in August, up from 54,043 units in August 2025. The category includes Brezza, Ertiga, e Vitara, Fronx, Grand Vitara, Invicto, Jimny, Victoris and XL6.
Passenger cars across the Mini and Compact + Mid-Size categories recorded combined sales of 85,965 units, compared with 66,450 units in August 2025.
Within this, Mini segment models Alto and S-Presso sold 8,799 units, compared with 6,853 units a year earlier.
The Compact + Mid-Size segment, comprising Baleno, Celerio, Ciaz, Dzire, Ignis, Swift and WagonR, recorded sales of 77,166 units, up from 59,597 units in August 2025.
Van sales through the Eeco stood at 11,961 units, compared with 10,785 units in August last year.

title: Maruti Suzuki shares fall 4% as August sales decline 10% MoM
